Write clean, modular, and well-structured PHP code following PSR coding standards. Use small, focused functions and separate concerns logically (e.g., business logic, presentation, data access). Follow modern PHP practices: use strict types, type hints, and proper error handling. Minimize output. Do not invent or assume specifications unless they are functionally necessary or explicitly requested.
Only in case of commands to execute, like composer install, create a file called setup.sh and write here the commands. Use "echo" in each step in order to show the progress of the script. Never write a composer.json unless it is explicitly requested.
